jobs.description:
Ria Money Transfer is a business arm of Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ: EEFT) and a leading financial services player. We offer fast, secure and affordable global money transfers to millions of customers worldwide. In addition to this, we also provide currency exchange services. With over 600,000 agents in almost 200 countries, our goal is to create opportunities for a better everyday life.
We believe in a world where everyone is empowered to shape the life they dream of, regardless of their background or location.
ABOUT THIS ROLE
Ria Financial Services is looking for a driven and service-oriented employee for the role of Sales Cashier/Store Employee. We are a global leader in money transfers and currency exchange with an extensive network of our own offices and branches.
This is a part-time position located in Stockholm. As a Sales Cashier/Store Employee, you will be a central part of our team and the face of our business. You will be responsible for delivering an outstanding customer experience while contributing to our sales goals.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Carry out transactions for money transfers and currency exchange with high precision and efficiency.
Actively engage customers to understand their needs and offer appropriate financial services.
Provide personalized and professional service by answering questions and providing clear guidance.
Manage cash flow carefully and ensure accurate accounting according to company guidelines.
Help achieve and exceed sales goals by building trust and customer loyalty.
Be flexible with working hours and be able to work evenings, weekends and holidays when needed.

 
We are looking for you who
Has experience in sales and customer service (meritorious).
Fluent in Swedish and English, with proficiency in a third language such as Georgian, Turkish, Russian or Ukrainian.
Is self-motivated, goal-oriented and thrives in a dynamic work environment.
Have a strong customer focus and the ability to create a positive experience for our customers.
Has experience in cashier work and handling of cash (meritorious).
Is flexible and can adapt to different tasks and shifts. Weekend work occurs.
Have basic computer skills (Word, Excel).

 
PERKS & BENEFITS
An exciting and dynamic work environment in an international company.
Opportunity to develop in sales and financial services.
An inclusive and multicultural team where we value diversity.

We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming you to our team at Ria Financial Services!
Please note that for security reasons, we request an extract from the criminal record before employment can be carried out.
 Ria Money Transfer is an employer that promotes equal opportunities. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all employees.
 Read more about us here: www.riamoneytransfer.com

Technogarden Life Science has extensive experience from the pharmaceutical industry, scientific research, biotechnology, medical technology, and food production. We always work according to the latest standards and regulations, and with great personal commitment.
In order to support our clients in the best possible way, we offer both consultants and recruitment in Life Science and MedTech. Thus, we can provide guidance, training, and seminars about the latest regulations. We are attentive to the world around us and knowledge transfer is an important part of every successful recruitment or consulting job.
We at Technogarden are currently looking for a colleague in our Life Science team who bring a couple of years experience as a Quality Assurance Specialist within the Pharmaceutical Industry. The assignment is at one of our clients who would like you to start asap with a minimum duration of one year.  
Responsibilities
Your responsibility at our Client is to coordinate Quality Activities within GDP with Quality Manager GDP. You will interact with subsidiaries and external counterparts at PWS and CMOs, review GDP documents from pre-wholesale/wholesaler/transporter and for controlled medicinal product:
Quality Agreements
Change Controls, Deviations and CAPAs

Further you should handle complaints and alerts from serialization system for medicinal products. You are also responsible for the preparation of documents for PQR. Further tasks:
Establish and evaluate Vendor Questionnaire (GDP)
Review, write, approve and implement SOPs within GDP and if applicable Pharma
Participate in vendor and customer qualification
Participate in quality risk management procedures for GDP

Qualifications
Educational
Academic degree within life science/engineering or pharmacy
Professional experience
Minimum 5 years within pharmaceutical industry or Quality Assurance
Technical/functional area skills
Beneficial with knowledge of applicable international standards and guidelines for Pharmaceuticals within GDP in EU and in national legislation as applicable.
Beneficial with experience of complaint, and deviation and change management
Your personality
We think (and like) that you have a positive mindset and a can-do attitude. You bring experience from previous QA rolls and can take decision based on facts, legislation and circumstance. As a person you are structured, systematic, efficient and you have an organized way of working.  You have excellent communication skills. 
Languages
You are fluent in written and spoken Swedish and English. 
Systems (IT)
Experienced user of MS Office package
Here at Technogarden you will be part of a really nice team of different professions within Life Science and Engineering but also a valuable and appreciated colleague at our Clients. The best of both worlds! We need your application asap. Please don´t hesitate to call or mail if you have any questions. Welcome!

About the Role
You love making things work. You're not in love with a specific solution or technology, but rather delivering value to users.
At Tandem, Software Engineers are the ones who turn ideas into products that make a real difference for clinicians and patients. You’ll take on whatever stands in the way of our product’s real-world impact, from designing and building new functionality to debugging complex systems, improving integrations, and making sure everything runs smoothly. The learnings and abstractions you build along the way will set the foundation for the next generation of the product offering.
You’ll see firsthand how the tech you build actually changes how healthcare works, and you’ll become one of the people who truly understand both the technical and operational sides of what we do.
This role is perfect for someone who’s obsessed with solving problems, who codes because they love it, and who cares more about impact than which part of the stack they work in. It’s a role for builders – people who want to learn fast, ship fast, and see their work make a difference immediately.
If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

What You Will Do
Design, build, deploy, and improve software that delivers real value to our users.
Debug and solve complex, real-world problems across infrastructure, APIs, data flows, RPA, and configuration.
Write clean, pragmatic code to build and extend our systems.
Collaborate with clinicians, partners, and our internal teams to understand problems, remove blockers, and deliver effective solutions.
Shape the next generation of our product through thoughtful engineering and rapid iteration.
Continuously identify, automate, and improve painful or inefficient processes so we can scale smarter.

What You Bring
Deep love for programming and problem-solving.
Curiosity that borders on obsession - you like understanding why things work (or don’t).
A bias toward action - you’d rather get things done than talk about them.
Comfort working in ambiguity and high velocity.
A mindset that leans toward ownership, creativity, and energy.

Key nice-to-haves
Experience with authentication and authorization
RPA experience
Any other language skills than a fluency in English is a plus, especially German.
Solid experience coding in Python, TypeScript, or C#.

Benefits
Competitive salary and company stock options.
30 days of paid holiday each year.
5,000 SEK wellness allowance, plus 6,000 SEK each year for other health-related initiatives.
Parental leave top-up for new parents.
Private medical insurance.
Mental health support through Mindler.
Pension programme.
Regular social and team activities, including off-sites and seasonal events.

We review our benefits regularly and may change them from time to time.

About the Role
As a Technical Lead, you will take responsibility for coordinating and driving technical activities in projects involving advanced automated crane systems.
You will work closely with engineers, project managers, and international customers, ensuring that technical solutions meet project requirements, quality standards, and deadlines.
The role combines technical leadership with project coordination. You will guide the engineering work, make technical recommendations, and help move projects forward, without having formal personnel management responsibilities.
Your Responsibilities
Coordinate and drive technical engineering activities from planning to delivery.

Provide technical guidance and support engineering teams in software, automation, and control systems.

Support project managers with technical decisions, planning, estimates, and risk assessments.

Ensure technical deliveries meet project requirements, quality standards, and deadlines.

Collaborate with international customers and stakeholders.

Identify technical challenges, find solutions, and improve engineering processes.

Who Are We Looking For?
We believe you have:

A master's degree in Engineering or equivalent qualifications, preferably within Automation, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or Computer Science.

Several years of experience in software development, software design, industrial automation, or PLC programming.

Experience coordinating technical activities or delivering complex engineering projects.

A good understanding of technical project management, engineering processes, and documentation.

The ability to take technical ownership, make decisions, and drive projects forward.

Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Fluency in Swedish and English.

Additional Qualifications
Experience with advanced industrial automation or control systems.

Previous experience as a Technical Lead, Lead Engineer, Senior Automation Engineer, or Technical Project Lead.

Experience working with international engineering projects.

You are structured, solution-oriented, and comfortable taking responsibility. You enjoy working with both technical details and the bigger picture, bringing people together to achieve successful project deliveries.
Why Join?
Work with advanced automation technology in international projects.

Take ownership of technical solutions and influence key decisions.

Combine engineering expertise with technical project leadership.

Collaborate with experienced engineers and international customers.

Develop your career within a well-established global technology company.

Practical Information
Location: Västerås, Sweden Start: As agreed Employment: Full-time Contract: Initial 12-month consultancy assignment through A-hub, with good opportunities for permanent employment with the client.
Interested?
Ready for a role where your technical expertise makes a real difference?
Apply today! We review applications continuously and look forward to hearing from you.
A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.
By submitting your application, you consent to A-hub processing your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy.

jobs.description:
The artistic director of the Royal Swedish Opera Tobias Theorell and Chorus master Jori Klomp invites to audition.
The Chorus of the Royal Swedish Opera is Sweden’s largest professional chorus and one of the oldest in the world, founded in 1773. The chorus consists of 48 full-time choristers who take part in the vast majority of all opera productions, which are performed throughout the season. 
The position 
Tenor 1, full-time, permanent employment with probationary year commencing the 1st of July 2027 or by agreement. 
Your profile
Details of education in music or postgraduate studies in opera are requested, and further details of experience as a member of an opera chorus are desirable.
You should have a good proficiency in either English or Swedish. If you cannot currently speak Swedish you are expected to learn.
Audition
The Audition will take place on Saturday the 27th of February 2027, by invitation and upon review of applications.
Please prepare the following for audition:
Mandatory aria (choose one of them):
Tenor 1 
Un aura amorosa (Così fan tutte)
Che gelida manina (La Bohème)
Pourqoui me reveiller (Werther)
One aria of your own choice in contrasting language and style to that of the mandatory aria.
The audition will also involve tests in sight-reading, chorus excerpts, stagecraft and an ensemble test.
The chorus excerpts and ensembles will be sent after invitation.
Your application 
Applications must be received no later than the 24th of January 2027. 
To be approved your application must be accompanied by CV, an attached mp3 sound file and photograph.
 
The mp3 sound file and the photo should be uploaded in the section "Other documents".
Apply at https://www.operan.se/en/careers by clicking on the button APPLY.
Union representative: Louise Reitberger, +46 8 791 43 00
Please address all questions to mailto:korprovsjungning@operan.se
 
As Sweden’s national stage for opera and ballet, the Royal Swedish Opera is committed to offering access to everyone and to inspiring strong emotions. Our values are expressed as Excellence, Welcoming, Fearless and Timeless. The Royal Swedish Opera is a limited company that is wholly-owned by the State with a turnover of c. SEK 600 million and with some 700 employees from over 20 countries representing 120 different professions.With over 200 opera and ballet performances, hundreds of concerts and several hundred activities for the young, each season offers a wide range of experiences – both within and outside of the opera house. The repertoire includes both classical and new works spanning from the Early to the Modern period.

In this role, you will work close to both technology and execution, contributing to the development, integration, and industrialization of electronic hardware products used in critical energy infrastructure.
You will operate at the intersection of system engineering and product development, collaborating closely with internal stakeholders and external suppliers throughout the full product lifecycle – from concept and requirements definition to production release and lifecycle maintenance. The role offers the opportunity to work in an international, agile environment where quality, safety, and reliable delivery are key success factors.
How you’ll make an impact
 Lead and contribute to hardware development and technology projects, ensuring alignment on scope, schedule, cost, quality, and technical performance.
Plan, track, and report project progress; proactively identify, document, and mitigate technical and organizational risks.
Collaborate closely with suppliers and operations to support industrialization and introduction of products into production.
Maintain accurate and structured documentation for specifications, system changes, and integration activities.
Drive continuous improvement of development processes to improve speed, quality, and cost effectiveness.

Your background
B.S. or M.S. in Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of technical project management and experience in hardware development.
Strong understanding of electronics, system integration, and industrial product development.
Experience from industrial and/or energy domains, preferably within power, automation, or control systems.
Proven ability to collaborate across functions and organizations; strong stakeholder and supplier management skills.
Comfortable working in agile development environments with multiple parallel priorities.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with a proactive and structured working approach.

Meet the Team
Join Cisco's Webex Media engineering site in Stockholm, where we craft the meeting experience that connects people and businesses around the world. We are a highly motivated, startup‑like team within a global organization, combining the impact and resources of Cisco with the agility and camaraderie of a smaller group. Our work powers the shift to a hybrid workforce and aims to make people feel truly connected. You’ll find a friendly, supportive environment that celebrates creativity, growth, and a shared passion for building world‑class real‑time audio algorithm experiences.

Your Impact
Design, implement, and optimize VoIP audio algorithms—including adaptive jitter buffers, packet loss concealment, and codec pipelines—based on product requirements.
Perform peer code reviews and automate development workflows and quality gates.
Participate in agile ceremonies including daily stand‑ups, planning, releases, and retrospectives.
Collaborate across teams to broaden technical and soft skills through training and mentoring.

Minimum Qualifications:
MSc (or equivalent) in Software Engineering or a related field.
Hands-on experience developing VoIP or real‑time audio algorithms (e.g., adaptive jitter buffer, packet loss concealment, codec integration) in production systems.
Proficiency in C/C++ with strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
Experience with media streaming and relevant protocols for real‑time applications.
Professional verbal and written communication skills in English.
Uses AI responsibly to accelerate development.
Critically reviews AI-generated code before using it.

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience applying AI/ML to audio algorithm development or optimization in production voice systems.
Experience evaluating and tuning audio algorithms using objective metrics (e.g., POLQA, PESQ) and subjective listening tests.
Experience with close‑to‑real‑time systems and performance‑sensitive code paths.
Comfort with incremental development, testing, and A/B testing in production.
Collaborative, friendly, and self‑directed; eager to learn and share knowledge.
Steers AI effectively via context and prompt design.

Why Cisco? 
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Proven project management experience in product development or a similar technical environment.
Strong planning, budgeting, coordination, and delivery management skills.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate alternative solutions and make decisions with limited information.
Ability to balance competing priorities while maintaining focus on business objectives and delivery quality.

Are you an engineer with a passion for sustainable technology and smart system design? This is your chance to be part of a global organization at the forefront of energy innovation. We work with ongoing selection - submit your application today.
About the role
As an Electrical Engineer within Cooling Systems, you will take part in the design, development, testing, and coordination of electrical systems in advanced energy transmission projects. Your main focus will be on cooling solutions for high-power conversion technology.
You’ll be part of a dedicated product delivery team with colleagues both in Sweden and abroad. The role involves close collaboration with suppliers, internal stakeholders, and technical experts, making it ideal for someone who enjoys combining engineering depth with cross-functional teamwork.
Whether you're early in your career or bring years of experience – our client believes in continuous learning. You’ll receive a thorough onboarding, including a 5-week “engineering camp” at the site in Ludvika, to ensure you get a strong start.
Work tasks
Design and develop electrical solutions for cooling systems in large-scale energy projects
Work with automation, signal handling, and testing - including programming tasks
Collaborate with global project teams across long-term international projects (3–10 years)
Occasionally travel for testing or supplier follow-ups (a few times per year)

We are looking for
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or similar – with strong interest in electrical/automation systems
A genuine interest in technology and the transition to green energy
Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken (company language)
Willingness to travel when required (short trips a few times per year)

It's a plus if you have
Experience with cooling systems in industrial applications, automation, or electrical components
Background in technical project teams, testing, and documentation
Programming skills – any language is a bonus (e.g. MATLAB)
Swedish language skills

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Supportive and collaborative
Goal-oriented
Responsible
Intellectually curious and eager to learn

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

What you'll do:
Within CERN's Finance and Administrative Processes Department (FAP), specifically the Accounting Services Group. We are looking for a dynamic person to join our General Accounting (GA) section and play an active role in the accounting of CERN's tangible and intangible assets, as well as its inventories. You will also support broader financial reporting activities and exciting accounting projects. There will be a particular focus on Property, Plant and Equipment (PPE).

As an experienced Accountant, you will join a team of seven professionals and play a key role in all activities related to asset accounting.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinate regular register(s) updates and reviews of useful lives and residual values with other CERN stakeholders.
- Analyse CERN projects to identify new assets or consolidation/upgrade of existing assets.
- Perform accounting entries related to movements of assets, depreciation/amortisation, and impairment tests.
- Support the ongoing ERP transformation project touching the areas of asset accounting and financial accounts.
- Perform balance sheet account reconciliations, including a reconciliation of assets register(s) to financial accounts.
- Maintain policies, procedures, and controls to ensure efficient, accurate, and compliant asset accounting.
- Coordinate physical assets counts.
- Support external auditors queries.
- Support preparation of the Organization's Financial Statements, including assets related notes and disclosures.
- Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

- Proven experience as a general accountant with a focus on asset accounting, such as Property, Plant and Equipment (PPE).
- Demonstrated experience with international accounting standards IFRS and/or IPSAS.
- Experience preferably acquired in a company handling large volumes of data or in an international organisation.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Accounting, Finance or a related field. Accounting certification, such as ACA, CA, CPA, etc.

Your skills:
- Accounting control and analysis, book-keeping and book-closing.
- Financial reporting and analysis, handling large volumes of data.
- Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
- Uses openness and honesty to interact constructively with others.
- Assimilates large quantities of information, identifies key issues and formulates conclusions clearly and concisely.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Job Overview
Role Summary
An experienced Performance Management / Data Mediation Engineer is needed for a consulting assignment focused on developing and maintaining data pipelines for performance data in a complex network and OSS environment. The role is responsible for building robust, scalable flows for collecting, transforming, and making performance data available from network elements and adjacent systems. The resulting data must be reliable, traceable, and usable for both operational monitoring and analytical purposes.
You will work across multiple data sources and integration patterns, contributing to the continued development of in-house capabilities, onboarding new data sources, and improving existing data models and flows. A key objective is to reduce dependency on external vendors by developing and maintaining internal solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, operate, maintain, and enhance data pipelines for network performance data.
Collect, transform, validate, and expose data from network elements and surrounding systems.
Implement integrations using protocols and patterns including SNMP, traps, REST APIs, file-based transfers, and streaming telemetry.
Ensure data reliability, traceability, quality, lineage, governance, and appropriate schema design.
Integrate performance-data solutions with adjacent inventory, topology, ITSM, and analytics systems.
Onboard new data sources and further develop existing data models, integrations, and operational flows.
Collaborate closely with architects, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and performance analysts to prioritize improvements and evolve the solution.
Contribute to knowledge transfer and the development of internal engineering capability.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Strong practical experience with Python, SQL, and ETL/ELT-based data processing.
Experience with data-pipeline scheduling and job orchestration.
Solid understanding of SNMP, MIBs, polling, traps, and streaming telemetry.
Experience with data quality, data lineage, data governance, and schema development.
Good understanding of DevOps principles and modern development and operations practices.
Experience with performance-management platforms such as OpenText NNMi/NOM, OPTIC Data Lake, or equivalent platforms is advantageous.
Experience with messaging technologies such as Kafka, MQ, or similar message buses is advantageous.
Experience with time-series and observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, or the ELK Stack is advantageous.

Qualifications & Experience
Documented experience designing and maintaining data pipelines within OSS, telecommunications performance management, or related network analytics environments is required. The ideal candidate combines data-engineering expertise with a practical understanding of network data collection and mediation. Fluent English communication skills are required. Additional Nordic or Baltic language skills are considered advantageous.

Job Overview
Role Summary
An experienced Full Stack Developer is needed for a strategic development initiative focused on modern, user-centric, and data-driven solutions. You will join a cross-functional product team and collaborate closely with analysts, business stakeholders, UX specialists, and product management. The role carries broad responsibility across frontend development and user experience, backend services, APIs, integrations, and technical decision-making.
You will build modern web applications with high requirements for performance, quality, security, and scalability. The assignment involves contributing actively to architecture and design decisions, integrating with internal services and external platforms, and working closely with UX to deliver intuitive and user-friendly interfaces.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain modern full-stack web applications.
Deliver frontend functionality, backend services, APIs, and integrations across relevant platforms and internal services.
Contribute to technical architecture, solution design, and technology selection.
Collaborate with UX specialists to create intuitive, accessible, and user-focused interfaces.
Ensure that solutions meet high standards for performance, scalability, quality, and application security.
Contribute to development processes, code standards, and DevOps ways of working.
Work in a product-oriented environment with frequent releases and short feedback loops.
Collaborate with analysts, product management, business stakeholders, and other members of the cross-functional team.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Modern frontend development using React, Vue.js, Next.js, or equivalent frameworks.
Backend development, API design, and systems integration.
Cloud-based development using Google Cloud Platform or an equivalent cloud platform.
CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.
Version control and collaborative development using Git and GitHub.
Security practices for web applications, including authentication and authorization.
Advantageous experience with BigQuery, Looker, and integrations with BI platforms.
Advantageous experience with Docker, container-based solutions, Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform, design systems, component libraries, and AI-assisted development tools such as Copilot or Claude.

Qualifications & Experience
You have at least 5 years of experience as a Full Stack Developer. You have solid experience delivering modern frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and cloud-based solutions. A strong understanding of web application security, authentication, and authorization is required. Experience working in cross-functional product development teams, with data-driven applications or analytics products, is advantageous. You communicate fluently in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.

jobs.description:

Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a specialist in family medicine looking for a workplace with a supportive atmosphere, skilled colleagues and close access to beautiful nature?
This role offers the chance to work in a primary care centre located in a border region between Sweden and Norway, with short travel distance to Oslo and good connections to other parts of the country.
About the role
As a family medicine specialist, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team where all professional competences are valued. The centre provides care throughout life, from assessment and diagnostics to treatment, follow-up, and rehabilitation.
Primary care here is rapidly developing with a strong focus on accessibility, digital solutions, and close collaboration with patients. The work environment is characterized by teamwork, engagement, and patient focus.
We offer
Mentorship or professional guidance from experienced colleagues.
Regular opportunities for continuous professional development.
A workplace that promotes health and offers wellness benefits.
Support with practical matters in case of relocation, such as housing, schools, and integration.

Requirements
Medical license and specialist certification in family medicine/general practice from an EU/EEA country
Eligibility for recognition by the Swedish National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen).
Good English skills and willingness to learn Swedish to B2/C1 level (language training provided).

Terms
Full-time, permanent position.
Start date by agreement.

Location
The area is known for its stunning natural surroundings with forests, lakes, and rich wildlife – perfect for those who appreciate outdoor life and a good work-life balance. You will also have easy access to cultural activities, sports and international cities.
What Dignus Medical offers you
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and approvals
Help with accommodation and relocation for you and your family
Access to a free Swedish language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype
